summary: The document deserializer forwarded enum deserialization to deserialize_any, presenting a map to an enum visitor and rejecting valid externally tagged enums such as [Plain]. The fix explicitly dispatches a single-entry table through visit_enum. Reverse only that document-level dispatch. The fix-added test in tests/enum_external_deserialize.rs expects [Plain] to deserialize as TheEnum::Plain and requires the easy feature. Both selected source regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were run.
expected_failure: invalid type: map, expected enum TheEnum
